Sary-OS Lite is the phone edition of Sary-OS: LiveLoop, AI chat and AI creation on the same account as www.sary-os.com, so what you make on your phone is waiting on your computer and the other way round.

LiveLoop lets you build whatever you can imagine, live. Not an app builder: a stage where anything you describe starts running as you watch, and keeps changing as you talk to it. Every version is kept, your files travel with it, and the same creation opens on desktop.


Build with LiveLoop
✨ Whatever you can imagine, built live in front of you: a 3D game with sound, a web app, a presentation, a document laid out with the images you attach, a music tool that doesn't exist yet, an interactive storybook, a simulation, a dashboard, a 3D model from a CAD drawing
✏️ Attach a 2D sketch and have it brought to life
🎤 Talk to LiveLoop: a real-time voice conversation you can interrupt at any moment, in any language
🔁 Change anything by saying so; the running creation updates in place
🕘 Every version kept; go back to any of them
💻 Pick up the same creation on your computer, with the full Sary-OS tools around it. Can start a job on your phone and close the app and it will work on the cloud without you being online.


Choose from today's leading models, or let Auto pick the best fit for each message: GPT-6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5.1, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, Grok 4.7 and Grok Build.

Start free
✅ Free account with 100 welcome credits
✅ 30-day Sary-OS trial: 1,000 credits for LiveLoop and 10 minutes of voice
✅ Chat on the free models (GPT-6 Luna and Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite)
✅ Buy credits when you want them, and they never expire

Create with AI
🖼️ Images with GPT-Image, Nano Banana and Grok Imagine, from a prompt or a reference photo
🎬 Video with sound from Veo, Kling, Seedance, Gemini Omni Flash and Luma
✍️ Doc: draft, summarise, rewrite, fix grammar, shorten, change the tone or translate any text
🗂️ Everything lands in your Gallery, synced with Sary-OS Drive

Chat
💬 Ask anything, in any language, with web search when you want it
🔁 Your chats on every device you sign in to
🌙 Dark, light or system appearance

Remembers what matters
With your permission, Sary-OS remembers lasting facts you share so answers feel more personal, on every device.

AskSary has become Sary-OS. Your account, chats and credits carry over.

For the full Sary-OS, with Studio, Code

quotes.text:
The Backstory
Exactly 30 days ago, I was frustrated. I kept switching between different AI apps — ChatGPT for reasoning, Gemini for speed, Grok for real-time news. Each had strengths, but none offered a single interface that could handle it all intelligently.
So, I decided to build it myself. The problem? I had zero coding experience.

The Learning Curve
When I started this journey last month, I had never touched a line of code or opened a terminal. I spent sleepless nights teaching myself everything from scratch. To give you an idea of the mountain I had to climb, 30 days ago I had zero experience with:
* Languages & IDEs: JavaScript, Android Studio, Visual Studio

* Infrastructure: GitHub (version control was a nightmare at first), Firebase

* AI Integrations: OpenAI API, Grok API, Gemini API, Tavily (for search)

* Business Logic: Stripe integration for payments

What I Built
The result is Ask AI — available now on Web & Android. It’s an all-in-one AI assistant designed to stop the “app fatigue.”
Key Features:
*  Auto-Model Routing: An engine that analyzes your prompt and automatically routes it to the best model (Gemini Flash for speed, GPT-5/Grok for complex tasks). Saves you money and time.

*  Visuals: Live 4K wallpapers and JavaScript-generated themes (Matrix, Terminal, Frosted Glass).

*  Real-Time Data: Integrated Tavily and Grok to fetch live web data.

*  Fair Pricing: A free tier that actually works (Nano models), plus a premium tier for heavy lifters.

Why This …
quotes.story_title: Built in 30 days by someone who had never coded before – ASK AI
